title: source – a book, register, database, document or work
description: Citation at source level (ADR 0023): repository, collection or call number, title. Records add the exact locator.

form.description: Original, derivative (copy, index, transcript, abstract) or authored work (ADR 0022).

volumes.description: Volumes of the source (ADR 0058), in the order of the archive – not necessarily by date; periods may overlap.

call_number.description: when the volume has its own signature

url.description: where the volume opens in the portal viewer

image_map.description: Page (or folio) → image of the portal viewer, from anchors read on the images (ADR 0061). One map per volume (and part with its own numbering); the offset may change inside a book, so each anchor is a point that was looked at, never a computed one.

volume.description: the volume this map is for; without it the map is for the whole source

part.description: part of the book with its own page numbering (a village, a section), as the book or portal names it (ADR 0068); one map per volume and part

unit.description: what the book numbers: pages (default) or folios with side (23r, 23v)

page.description: page number printed on the image

folio.description: folio with side printed on the image, e.g. 23r

image.description: image number in the portal viewer

items.x-hint: an anchor needs page or folio

portal.description: Portal id from the catalogue of the regional packages (regions/*/portals.yaml); the access mode of the portal applies (ADR 0064).

access.description: How this source can be read, when it differs from its portal or has none (ADR 0064).

mode.description: automated – tools may fetch; link – tools build links, a person reads; manual – a person searches online; on-site – reading room or office; request – only by a written request; none – not accessible now.

held_by.description: Who holds it: archive, registry-office (books not yet handed to the archive), parish, other.

citation.description: Full citation in words (Evidence Explained style).

original_file.description: Path to the original (PDF, scan) in the family repo.

terms.description: Licence / terms of use of images from this source.

x-hint: needs collection or call_number (unless form is authored)
